ull fact[300005], invfact[300005];

inline ull mod_pow(ull base, ull exp) {
    ull result = 1;
    while (exp) {
        if (exp & 1ULL) result = (result * base) % MOD;
        base = (base * base) % MOD;
        exp >>= 1ULL;
    }
    return result;
}

inline ull nCr(int a, int b) {
    return (((fact[a] * invfact[b]) % MOD) * invfact[a - b]) % MOD;
}

    int limit = (int)max(N, K);
    fact[0] = 1ULL;
    for (int i = 1; i <= limit; ++i) fact[i] = fact[i - 1] * (ull)i % MOD;
    invfact[limit] = mod_pow(fact[limit], MOD - 2ULL);
    for (int i = limit - 1; i >= 0; --i) invfact[i] = invfact[i + 1] * (ull)(i + 1) % MOD;

    for (int i = 1; i <= (int)N; ++i) dp[1][i] = invfact[i];

    ull ans = dp[1][(int)N] * nCr((int)K, 1) % MOD;
    int maxLayer = min(18, (int)K);

    for (int i = 2; i <= maxLayer; ++i) {

            if (dp[i - 1][j] == 0) continue;

        ans = (ans + res >= MOD) ? ans + res - MOD : ans + res;
    }

    ans = ans * fact[(int)N] % MOD;
    return ans;
